name: myhealthspan
description: Personal health intelligence — connects wearables + medical records, synthesizes insights with clinical-grade AI analysis

tools.name: mhs_health_status
tools.description: Get a comprehensive health status summary including vitals, sleep, activity, and drift alerts

tools.name: mhs_ask
tools.description: Ask a natural language question about your health data and get an AI-synthesized answer

tools.name: mhs_get_labs
tools.description: Retrieve lab results and biomarker panels with reference ranges and trend analysis

tools.name: mhs_get_vitals
tools.description: Get current and historical vital signs — heart rate, HRV, blood pressure, SpO2, temperature

tools.name: mhs_get_sleep
tools.description: Retrieve sleep data including duration, stages, efficiency, and sleep score

tools.name: mhs_get_activity
tools.description: Get activity and exercise data — steps, calories, workouts, strain score

tools.name: mhs_get_conditions
tools.description: List medical conditions from connected EHR systems

tools.name: mhs_get_medications
tools.description: List current and past medications from connected health records

tools.name: mhs_get_allergies
tools.description: List known allergies and adverse reactions from health records

tools.name: mhs_detect_drift
tools.description: Detect baseline drift in health metrics — identifies when values deviate from your personal normal

tools.name: mhs_chart_data
tools.description: Get time-series data formatted for charting — supports vitals, sleep, activity, and lab trends

tools.name: mhs_connect_device
tools.description: Connect a wearable device (Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Garmin, Apple Watch, Fitbit)

tools.name: mhs_connect_ehr
tools.description: Connect to a hospital or health system via FHIR/SMART to pull medical records

tools.name: mhs_earnings
tools.description: View earnings from contributing anonymized health research data via XSpan Contribute
